entries.title: LoadGameEntriesAsync's manifest parser bypassed JsonRead at five call sites, so one JSON-null field silently dropped the rest of that folder's games

occurrences.note: New this loop, and resolved the same loop: found while re-deriving F-001's evidence per the Anchor-check requirement, then independently verified via a new xunit test (JsonReadTests.cs) that the raw Windows.Data.Json GetNamedString overloads throw InvalidOperationException on a present-JSON-null member and that ContainsKey does not guard against it. All five call sites (id, addedDate, imagePath, title, installLocation/executableName) now route through JsonRead. Reviewer verdict: approved (reality/honesty/regression all passed). sha patched to the real commit sha in a same-loop follow-up commit once HEAD is known (self-referential sha cannot be embedded in the commit that creates it - same constraint loop 2's F-002 resolution hit).
